run: Harbourline Studio Ltd, September 2026 month-end supplier payment run
source: data/emails.md (inbox accounts@harbourline.co.uk, folder Suppliers / September 2026, exported 2026-09-30 08:05)
brief_from_principal: Run ready for sign-off by 1 October 2026. Bring the principal only what the payments policy reserves for them.
scope_note: Built from the inbox export only. I did not read the PO list, the bank feed or the supplier master, so the checks under open_items_for_reconciler are not done. The decision on each record is a proposal for the reconciler to confirm.
conventions: One record per email, oldest first (id E01 to E12 matches message_no). Amounts are as stated on the document, in the document currency, as numbers. document_date is the date printed on the document, or null if none is printed (received always has the email time). Every GBP invoice adds up: net + vat = gross, vat = 20% of net. Credit note amounts are positive and direction says credit.
open_items_for_reconciler: Bank feed, policy 6: confirm E01, E06, E08 and E05 are not already paid.
Bank feed, policy 7: look for a GBP 300.00 refund from Marlow dated 2026-09-09 with reference CN-012 (E04). MD-2026-049 is said to have been paid on 2026-08-28.
PO list, policy 4: variance against PO-1041 (E01), PO-1039 (E06), PO-1044 (E08, net GBP 5.00 higher than the superseded E07) and PO-1046 (E05, PO currency unknown to me).
Supplier master, policy 8: pay to the details on file. E11 asks for new Northfield details by email; the call-back number on file is yours to look up. E05 says a USD account is on file at Kestrel.

Reserved for the principal and NOT escalated by me: E11 bank-detail change request (policy 8 and 9); E06 approval above GBP 2,000.00 before it is scheduled (policy 3). E05 is a USD invoice in a GBP run: policy 2 only describes a GBP run, so if you agree the policy does not cover it, policy 10 applies.
